Record Class GameSaveSummary

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.ntnu.idi.idatt2003.millions.infrastructure.persistence.GameSaveSummary
Record Components:
id - the database identifier of the saved game
label - the user-defined label for the save entry
exchangeName - the name of the exchange in the saved game
week - the current simulation week at save time
createdAt - the timestamp when the save entry was created
public record GameSaveSummary(long id, String label, String exchangeName, int week, Instant createdAt) extends Record
Summary of a saved game entry.
